newsitem.title: VATICAN: Pope to publish brief memoirs.
newsitem.headline: Pope to publish brief memoirs.

text.p: Pope John Paul plans to publish a brief volume of memoirs covering parts of the 50 years since he was ordained a priest, church sources said on Thursday.
The volume is expected to deal with the Pope's recollections of his youth, the World War Two period in his native Poland and his life as a young priest and bishop.
The memoirs are expected to revolve around his reflections of the Roman Catholic priesthood in general and his own experiences in particular, the sources said.
They are expected to take the form of a short booklet and be issued by the Vatican publishing house. The date of publication has not been decided.
The 76-year-old Pope, the former Cardinal Karol Wojtyla of Krakow, marks the 50th anniversary of his ordination as a Roman Catholic priest on Friday.
The Pope's 1995 book, "Crossing the Threshold of Hope", was an international bestseller. It was published by commercial publishing houses around the world and the royalties went to charity.
